notes.titleEn: Site renamed AI UP LAB, Agent UI library added
notes.bodyEn: Public brand is AI UP LAB: a reusable AI collection lab · cases / pages / Agent UI. The header now has three libraries: Grok Bot (amber), HTML Collection (teal), Agent UI (violet). Agent UI’s first batch is free ThreeUI Community components (MIT, no login); copy a prompt / Skill.md to retheme. No Pro, no MCP. Grok Bot and HTML data and routes stay the same.

notes.title: 界面：近日更新时间线与收录理由
notes.body: 双库首页增加按 updatedAt 分组的「今日收录 / 近日更新」，卡片展示收录理由（qualityNote），并加上当前库搜索、上手路径与 /search 两库检索。不是行业新闻站。
notes.titleEn: UI: recent-update timeline and why we listed it
notes.bodyEn: The dual-library home gained “listed today / recent updates” grouped by updatedAt. Cards show why we listed it (qualityNote), plus in-library search, a start path, and /search across both libraries. Not an industry news site.

notes.title: Bot 补 1 条官方 Skill 教学，HTML 收集 +5
notes.body: Grok Bot：新增官方「Teach a task → Skill → Routine」演示教学案例。HTML 收集：新增 CSS Zen Garden、Scroll-driven Animations、Squoosh、Clippy、css-doodle。
notes.titleEn: Bot adds 1 official Skill lesson; HTML Collection +5
notes.bodyEn: Grok Bot: added the official “Teach a task → Skill → Routine” demo case. HTML Collection: added CSS Zen Garden, Scroll-driven Animations, Squoosh, Clippy, and css-doodle.

notes.title: v1.0.0 种子数据入库
notes.body: 收录 20 条公开资料中的精选用法，覆盖官方文档与发布稿、社区多 Agent 实践，以及 Cursor Automations 相邻的工程工厂模式。原始记录见 data/cases.json。
notes.titleEn: v1.0.0 seed data checked in
notes.bodyEn: Listed 20 selected uses from public sources, covering official docs and launch posts, community multi-agent practice, and Cursor Automations-adjacent engineering-factory patterns. Raw records are in data/cases.json.

notes.title: 新增独立「HTML 收集」库
notes.body: 顶部增加 HTML 收集标签，数据在 data/html-items.json，与 Grok Bot 案例分开。首批收录 12 条可公开访问的演示、模板、组件与工具页。
notes.titleEn: Added a separate HTML Collection library
notes.bodyEn: The header gained an HTML Collection tab. Data lives in data/html-items.json, separate from Grok Bot cases. First batch: 12 publicly reachable demos, templates, components, and tool pages.
